svg.title: Layout v3: New York Countdown
svg.text: Layout v3 · New York Countdown · proposal, not decided
Two districts of five holes beside the runway, each looping back to one hub at the runway tip. Drawn on the 18 Nov tape measurements (plan v2).
Positions sit on values that are not measured yet (stage depth, stair and speaker-stand positions): treat them as ±1 m. Stars mark props over 2 m.
Runway (raised, part of the stage) · 22.54 × 2.4 m · players can't cross
skyline flats on the wall (2.4–3.6 m), then a 1.2 m walkway
skyline flats on the wall (2.4–3.6 m), then a 1.2 m walkway
Golf limit · 27 m from the stage front (decided 18 Nov)
Routes don't cross. Groups can start at
any open hole and play their district
Golf zone after the runway: ≈ 637 m²
LED colour at the deck base.
Not shown: cable runs and drops (on the old cable-plan geometry; to re-place), and the runway extension (if built it would run through the hub, which would then split in two).
